messages:
emily: Heads-up — invoice INV-2028-1345 for ACME ($120,000 net) was posted and the system recognized full revenue on 2028-03-15 instead of deferring. Need an adjusting entry and rev-schedule fix for month-end close.

raj: Can you drop the invoice id, tax treatment, and the system timestamp? We'll need the JE details to file.

emily: Invoice ID: INV-2028-1345. Net amount = $120,000 (tax excluded). Billing event created by billing service on 2028-03-15 09:12 UTC (billing-bot posted). Recognition rule should have been 12-month straight-line starting 2028-04-01 (monthly $10k). Current bad entry: revenue recognized immediately.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2028-1345 created by chargeflow at 2028-03-15T09:12:03Z. Amount: 120000.00 USD. Recognize_rule: NONE (bug flagged).

marta: Is there any usage or credits applied that change net? Tax?

emily: No usage/credits. Tax handled separately on a different line item. This is pure reserved capacity prepay.

kevin: Ok — accounting impact to reverse full recognition and move to deferred. Proposed reversing JE (to correct March recognized revenue):

```
Date: 2028-03-31
Journal: ADJ-ME-2028-03-ACME
Debit 4100 Recognized Revenue        120,000.00
Credit 2200 Deferred Revenue        120,000.00
Memo: Reverse premature recognition for INV-2028-1345; reclass to unearned revenue to be recognized monthly starting Apr 1.
```

raj: That looks right. Also we need to update our revenue schedule table for ACME so future runs don't re-recognize. Who will patch the schedule?

emily: I'll update the RevSchedule service and mark the invoice mapping to a 12-month schedule (start 2028-04-01). Will also add a note on the invoice record: "post-close JE applied to reverse full recognition — schedule applied."

marta: Please confirm which GL code to use for the deferred side — we use 2200 for Unearned/Deferred. Confirm JE tag for audit.

kevin: JE tag requested: MEC-2028-03-Adj1. Put supporting docs: invoice PDF, billing audit log, and a screenshot of the RevSchedule change. Also include who approved.

emily: Will attach docs and queue JE in NetSuite with tag MEC-2028-03-Adj1. NetSuite form: JE > Subsidiary: Redwood, Currency USD. I'll put myself as preparer and request approval from raj.

raj: Approved. One more ask — please run the revenue rollforward after the JE and attach summary to the month-end pack. We need the impact on ARR and recognized revenue for March and subsequent months.

emily: Will do. Expected P&L impact: reduce recognized revenue for Mar by $120k; increase deferred by $120k. Starting Apr, monthly recognized revenue +$10k for 12 months. Impact on ARR: no change to ARR calculation for committed ARR (still $120k annual), but recognized revenue timing changes.

kevin: Thanks. Emily — can you post the JE number here once posted and add links to the attached docs? Also confirm if any tax remittance needs reversing (probably not but check).

emily: Will post JE number (NS-589712) after posting. Tax no change — separate line-item. I will update the pack and ping when done.

raj: Good. For the close checklist: 1) Post JE, 2) Update RevSchedule (emily), 3) Attach docs (emily), 4) Run rollforward + attach (kevin to validate), 5) Finance lead sign-off (raj).

marta: Noted. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

emily: Posting JE now, will confirm when done.

billing-bot: JE NS-589712 created by emily at 2028-03-31T17:42:10Z — Status: Pending Approval.

emily: JE posted (NS-589712) and supporting docs attached to the folder: /finance/month-end/2028-03/ACME_INV-2028-1345. Rollforward snapshot attached. Kevin — can you quick-verify numbers?

kevin: Verified. Numbers tie to the rollforward. Closing this thread; will include in final close deck. :white_check_mark:
